title: 12 Best Bucharest Street Food & Romanian Cuisine
description: Discover the 12 best street food stalls and traditional Romanian restaurants in Bucharest. From mici at Obor Market to sarmale at historic taverns, find your next culinary adventure.

places.name: Caru' cu Bere
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sarmale cu Mămăliguță (cabbage rolls with polenta) or Ciolan de porc cu fasole (pork knuckle with beans)

places.name: Hanu' lui Manuc
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mici (grilled skinless sausages) or Tocăniță (stew) followed by Papanași (fried doughnuts)

places.name: La Cocosatu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mici (as many as you can eat!) with extra mustard, and a cold beer.

places.name: Cartofisserie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A large baked potato with crispy bacon, cheddar, sour cream, and chives.

places.name: Covrigi Luca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Covrig cu Susam (with sesame seeds) or a Covrig cu Brânză (with cheese filling) if you're feeling adventurous.

places.name: Stradale Floreasca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pork Shoulder Sandwich' or one of their daily changing chef's specials, always fresh and flavorful.

places.name: Lacrimi si Sfinti
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their reinterpretations of traditional dishes like 'Ciorba de burtă' (tripe soup) or their specialty meats, often paired with unique polenta variations.

places.name: Mahala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Mămăliguță cu jumări și ouă de prepeliță' (polenta with cracklings and quail eggs) as a starter, or any of their seasonal main courses.

places.name: Ciorbăria Centrală
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ciorbă de burtă (tripe soup) or Ciorbă de fasole cu afumătură (bean soup with smoked pork), served with hot peppers and sour cream.

places.name: Piața Obor Street Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A plate of mici from any of the lively stalls, paired with mustard and a fresh covrig. Also try some plăcintă for dessert.

places.name: Burger Van (e.g., Verde Stop Arena location)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Classic' or 'Cheeseburger' for a solid experience, or their monthly special for something unique. Don't forget the fries!

places.name: Cofetăria Georgescu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Amandina (chocolate cake with rum syrup), Savarina (rum-soaked sponge cake with cream), or a slice of their famous Doboș cake.
